Rare.name: Black Whirlwind
Rare.desc: When a "Blackwing" monster is Normal Summoned to your field: You can add 1 "Blackwing" monster from your Deck to your hand with less ATK than that monster.

Rare.name: Caius the Shadow Monarch
Rare.desc: If this card is Tribute Summoned: Target 1 card on the field; banish that target, and if you do, inflict 1000 damage to your opponent if it is a DARK monster.

Rare.name: Disturbance Strategy
Rare.desc: Your opponent shuffles their entire hand into the Deck, then draws the same number of cards.

Rare.name: Enraged Battle Ox
Rare.desc: If a Beast, Beast-Warrior, or Winged Beast-Type monster you control attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent.

Rare.name: Fires of Doomsday
Rare.desc: Special Summon 2 "Doomsday Tokens" (Fiend/DARK/Level 1/ATK 0/DEF 0) in Defense Position. They cannot be Tributed for a Tribute Summon, unless it is for a DARK monster. You cannot Summon other monsters the turn you activate this card (but you can Normal Set).

Rare.name: Frost and Flame Dragon
Rare.desc: Cannot be Normal Summoned/Set. Must be Special Summoned (from your hand) by banishing 1 FIRE and 2 WATER monsters from your Graveyard, and cannot be Special Summoned by other ways. Once per turn: You can discard 1 card to target 1 monster on the field; destroy that target.

Rare.name: Gagaga Magician
Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can declare a Level from 1 to 8; this card becomes that Level until the End Phase. You can only control 1 "Gagaga Magician". This card cannot be used as a Synchro Material Monster.

Rare.name: Gaia Soul the Combustible Collective
Rare.desc: Once per turn: You can Tribute up to 2 Pyro-Type monsters; this card gains 1000 ATK for each. If this card attacks a Defense Position monster, inflict piercing battle damage to your opponent. During the End Phase: Destroy this card.

Rare.name: Gogogo Golem
Rare.desc: Once per turn, this Defense Position card cannot be destroyed by battle.

Rare.name: Horn of the Phantom Beast
Rare.desc: Target 1 Beast or Beast-Warrior monster you control; equip this card to that target. It gains 800 ATK. If the equipped monster destroys your opponent's monster by battle and sends it to the GY: Draw 1 card.

Rare.name: Kurivolt
Rare.desc: You can target 1 Xyz Monster that has material; detach 1 material from it, and if you do, Special Summon 1 "Kurivolt" from your Deck. Cannot be used as Synchro Material.

Rare.name: Mirror Force
Rare.desc: When an opponent's monster declares an attack: Destroy all your opponent's Attack Position monsters.

2 Level 3 monsters
Once per turn: You can detach 1 Xyz Material from this card; this card gains 500 ATK. If this card has no Xyz Material, it cannot attack your opponent directly.

Rare.name: Salamandra

Rare.name: Skilled Dark Magician
Rare.desc: Each time a Spell Card is activated, place 1 Spell Counter on this card when that Spell resolves (max. 3). You can Tribute this card with 3 Spell Counters on it; Special Summon 1 "Dark Magician" from your hand, Deck, or GY.

Rare.name: Solidarity
Rare.desc: If you have only 1 original Type of monster in your Graveyard, all monsters you control with the same Type gain 800 ATK.

Rare.name: Super-Nimble Mega Hamster
Rare.desc: FLIP: You can Special Summon 1 Level 3 or lower Beast-Type monster from your Deck in face-down Defense Position.

Rare.name: Ultimate Baseball Kid
Rare.desc: This card gains 1000 ATK for each face-up FIRE monster on the field, except this card. You can send 1 other face-up FIRE monster you control to the Graveyard; inflict 500 damage to your opponent.

Rare.name: Wonder Wand
Rare.desc: Equip only to a Spellcaster monster. It gains 500 ATK. If you control the equipped monster and this card: You can send both to the GY; draw 2 cards.

Rare.name: Zubaba Knight
Rare.desc: At the start of the Damage Step, if this card attacks a face-up Defense Position monster: Destroy that monster.
